method.time: first recorded answer_created_at minus question_created_at; ties resolved by answer_id for first mapping
method.rank_weight: pooled expanded2000 answered reference, average rank ties, w=1-(1-floor)*(rank-1)/(N-1); never rank within category
method.scope: conditional on observed answers; no censoring cutoff assumed, no survival or population response-probability claim
method.classification: Beyer overlapping help-seeking intents; NMF groups are technical topics, not intent; numeric cluster IDs remain unrenamed
method.scores: frozen original baseline0/1/2 with known semantic validity limitations; weighted product is exploratory ordinal index, not validated quality
limits: No new inference or new labels. No Campos three-class test.
No formal significance search; year-stratified summaries expose possible composition effects.
Topic versus score matched support is small and explicitly separate from larger time-only support.
No new reserved80 analysis: entire original blinded pool excluded from new topic joins.
Year stratification is descriptive, not causal adjustment.
method.ai_use: Codex code/statistical analysis of existing Qwen and collaborator labels; not human gold
